expo.name: Kiongozi Chat
expo.description: Kenya's civic social network — connect with youth, share your voice, and chat with an AI guide on governance, civic rights, and the green economy.

infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kiongozi opens your photo library when you choose a photo or video to attach to a post or message, or to set your profile picture, for example a photo from a community clean-up you are posting about.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kiongozi uses your camera when you choose to take a photo for a message or film a clip for Mzinga, for example a picture of a notice from your county office.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kiongozi uses your microphone to record sound when you film a clip for Mzinga, for example a short video of a youth meeting with what people said.
